falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low formation; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural support level of that August bottom pattern, invalidating the analog and suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 typically signals complacency/premium exhaustion; sustained VIX above 25 indicates fear-driven repricing and forced deleveraging, which contradicts the 'HOLD' signal's assumption of stable-to-declining volatility supporting the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals growth scare flight-to-safety, not the soft-landing/recovery dynamic implied by the August 2024 bottom pattern; it would confirm macro deterioration rather than the 'unknown' verdict's embedded assumption of benign consolidation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
